properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] ExpressRoute: Audit MACsec Encryption on ExpressRoute Direct
properties.description: Audits that MACsec (802.1AE) encryption is enabled on ExpressRoute Direct circuits. FedRAMP High requires cryptographic protection of data in transit (SC-8) and use of FIPS-validated cryptographic mechanisms (SC-13). MACsec provides Layer 2 encryption between the customer edge and Microsoft edge routers, protecting all traffic traversing the ExpressRoute Direct physical ports.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance when MACsec encryption is not enabled on ExpressRoute Direct. Disabled: Do not evaluate. Note: MACsec is only available on ExpressRoute Direct — standard ExpressRoute circuits use IPsec via VPN Gateway for encryption.
